title: Non-thermal plasma upgrading of humidified CO2 into syngas in a dielectric barrier discharge reactor: tuning H2/CO ratios via specific energy input and gas flow rate
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, 5,354-364
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00293A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maxwell Klein, Joshua Jack
This study uncovers how specific energy input and gas flow rate govern syngas formation from humidified CO2 in dielectric barrier discharge reactors. The findings offer a foundation for optimizing plasma-driven CO2 and H2O conversion into syngas.
